title: The Secret F-19 That Never Existed

lines.text: For years, people were sure a secret F-19 stealth fighter existed.
In July nineteen eighty-six, the Air Force sealed off a crash site in Nevada, and the rumors exploded.
The jet that crashed was actually an F-117, still classified at the time.
No real F-19 has ever been shown to exist.
Even stranger: the F-117 got an F for fighter, with no air-to-air mission at all.
